<!-- Title: keep under ~72 chars. Start with type/scope: e.g. feat(parser): fix tokenization -->
## Summary
Short (1-2 sentences) description of what this PR changes.

## What & Why
- **What:** Describe the change (code paths, key files, algorithms).
- **Why:** Explain the reason and the user or product impact (motivation, bug root cause).

## How To Test
1. Steps to reproduce previous behavior (if applicable).
2. Exact steps to verify this change locally (commands, env vars, sample inputs).
3. Expected outcome.

## Checklist
- [ ] The change is limited to one purpose (feature / fix / refactor).
- [ ] Tests added or updated (unit / integration) where appropriate.
- [ ] Documentation updated (README, CHANGELOG, or docs/) where appropriate.
- [ ] Code formatted and linted locally.
- [ ] CI passes for all required checks.

## Linked Issues
Closes #<issue-number> (if applicable)  
Related: #<issue-number>

## Screenshots / Logs
Attach screenshots or relevant logs if the PR affects UI or complex flows.

## Notes for the Reviewer
- Points to review closely (edge cases, performance, API changes).
- Any follow-up work required after merge.

## Release Notes / Breaking Changes
- If this PR introduces a breaking change, add a clear `BREAKING:` line here describing user-facing impact.
